mission.seo_description: Why this site exists: making access to rights simpler for everyone.
mission.title: Our mission
mission.description: Why this site exists: helping everyone find their rights and the right people.
mission.intro: This site is made to <0>help everyone</0> find the right benefits and the right people.
mission.why.title: Why does this site exist?
mission.why.who: Because we do not always know who to turn to.
mission.why.everyone: Because everyone has the right to be helped.
mission.for_whom.title: Who is it for?
mission.for_whom.you: <0>For you:</0> if you are looking for a benefit, a form or advice.
mission.for_whom.pros: <0>For professionals:</0> social workers can use it to guide the people they support.
mission.not.title: What the site does not do
mission.not.text: We give reliable information. But we do not replace the CAF (family benefits office), the Sécu (social security) or France Travail. We help you contact them.
mission.commitments.title: Our commitments
mission.commitments.simple: Simple sentences. The “easy-to-read” versions are being prepared: they have not yet been reviewed by readers.
mission.commitments.no_ads: No advertising, no selling of data, no audience measurement.
mission.commitments.verified: Each page is checked against its official source before it is published, and dated.
mission.commitments.decides: Only the organisation concerned decides on your rights: we help you find it.
mission.start.title: Get started
mission.start.demarches: Complete a procedure step by step
mission.start.structures: Find a support centre near you
method.seo_description: How the information is collected, simplified and automatically checked against its official sources.
method.title: Our method
method.description: How each page is made, simplified and checked against its official source.
method.intro: So that you can trust it, we explain how each page is made. Nothing is published without being checked against its official source. This check is automatic: it is the AccesDirectAide system that re-reads the source, not a person and not the administration.
method.steps.collect.title: 1. Collection
method.steps.collect.text: We read the official sources (Service-Public, public directories).
method.steps.simplify.title: 2. Simplification
method.steps.simplify.text: A model installed on our machines writes the easy-to-read version; it is checked sentence by sentence against the source.
method.steps.verify.title: 3. Checking
method.steps.verify.text: The automatic check compares the page with its official source; a page that it does not confirm stays on hold.
method.steps.publish.title: 4. Publication
method.steps.publish.text: Online, with its source and the date of the check. It is checked again regularly.
method.statuses.title: Statuses of our content
method.statuses.draft.label: Draft
method.statuses.draft.text: The article is being written. No one can see it.
method.statuses.review.label: Under review
method.statuses.review.text: The page is waiting to be checked: its source has not confirmed it yet, or it has changed. It is not published.
method.statuses.published.label: Published
method.statuses.published.text: The automatic check has confirmed it against its source: you can read it on the site, with the date of this check. News items taken from an official website are published with their source.
method.statuses.refused.label: Rejected
method.statuses.refused.text: The source does not confirm the information, or it has disappeared: the page is removed from the site, with the reason.
method.report.title: Report an error
method.report.text: Anyone can make a mistake. If you see an error, <0>report it using the contact form</0>: every report is read, and the page is checked again against its source.
sources.list.aides_territoires: National and local database of public aid schemes
sources.list.annuaire: Addresses, opening hours and contact details of public services (support centres)
sources.list.sirene: Existence, address and activity of associations and organisations (establishment open or closed)
sources.seo_description: How we find and simplify information on benefits with open data and AI (FALC).
sources.title: Sources and method
sources.description: Transparency is the basis of trust. Find out how carefully we gather information and make it easy to understand.
sources.ai.title: The role of AI? Helping to simplify, never deciding.
sources.ai.drafts: The texts in <0>FALC (easy to read and understand)</0> are first drafts, prepared by an AI model installed on our own machines or by an automatic summary.
sources.ai.checked: Each text is checked automatically against the official source before publication (no invented number, no contradicted condition), and the page states that it was checked automatically; a text is presented as reviewed by a person only if a person has actually reviewed it.
sources.ai.no_rules: AI sets neither conditions nor amounts: they come only from the official sources cited on each page.
sources.origin.title: Government origin
sources.origin.text: An automatic check re-reads each page against its official source (open public data from the State): a page is published only if its source confirms it, and it is removed or put on hold when the source changes or disappears.
sources.charter.title: Our data quality charter
sources.charter.updates.title: Regular updates
sources.charter.updates.text: Our connector synchronises with government databases to keep the schemes up to date. Outdated pages are moved to "Archived".
sources.charter.trace.title: Full traceability
sources.charter.trace.text: Each checked page shows its official source and the date of the last check, with a link to view the source on the official website.
sources.red_lines.title: Absolute red lines
sources.red_lines.scraping: Scraping blogs or forums that cite no sources
sources.red_lines.eligibility: Stating that a user is formally eligible (only official calculators such as mes-droits-sociaux.gouv.fr are authoritative)
sources.red_lines.premium_numbers: Offering paid "premium-rate" phone numbers to reach public administrations
sources.loop.title: Human improvement loop
sources.loop.text: Institutions and citizens can at any time correct a benefit page that may contain a typo, using the <0>Report</0> button. The team reads every report and corrects the page if necessary; no time frame is guaranteed for now.
sources.loop.report: Report an error in the database
apropos.seo_description: Discover the origins, mission and commitments of Accès Direct Aide in tackling the non-take-up of rights.
apropos.title: Our story and our mission
apropos.description: Born in response to administrative complexity, Accès Direct Aide is committed to guaranteeing access at your fingertips, for everyone.
apropos.origin.title: The starting point (the spark)
apropos.origin.text: The idea for Accès Direct Aide came from a striking observation by our founder, who has worked for several years as a social worker in the Bas-Rhin, in work-integration projects and various other associations for social reintegration and housing. Faced with the growing number of online-only procedures and institutional jargon, he saw the digital divide make insecurity worse.
apropos.origin.non_take_up: <0>Many people give up on rights</0> simply because the information cannot be found or is “too hard to read”.
apropos.mission.title: Our civic mission
apropos.mission.text: Breaking down "silos" and using digital tools (open public data from the State, an artificial intelligence model installed on our own machines to write the easy-to-read versions, with no outside AI service) not to sell, but to <0>translate the State for citizens and to support "front-line" social work professionals</0>.
apropos.mission.quote: “A right that is not understood is a right that is not used. Translating the administration into "everyday" French is the first step towards equality.”
apropos.pillars.title: Our 4 unshakeable pillars
apropos.pillars.free.title: Completely free
apropos.pillars.free.text: Social information is not for sale: access is free for people, with no advertising and no paid ranking.
apropos.pillars.falc.title: Easy to read (FALC)
apropos.pillars.falc.text: Texts that are easy to read and understand: a model run by AccesDirectAide writes them from the official source; they are checked automatically before publication and labelled as such (they have not been tested with readers).
apropos.pillars.neutral.title: Neutrality
apropos.pillars.neutral.text: No political, philosophical or religious bias. Just rights for everyone.
apropos.pillars.security.title: Security by design
apropos.pillars.security.text: Messages, notes and documents encrypted when stored; every access to a file is logged and subject to the person’s consent.
apropos.deployment.title: Roll-out: a local and national vision
apropos.deployment.text: A national base makes it possible to present the benefits common to the whole of France (France Travail, CAF, Assurance retraite). However, the real strength of solidarity lies in the local network.
apropos.deployment.pilot.title: Pilot phase (Strasbourg)
apropos.deployment.pilot.text: Launch in Strasbourg and the Eurométropole (Bas-Rhin) to test the accuracy of local association data, for immediate usefulness to social workers in Alsace.
apropos.deployment.region.title: Grand Est stage
apropos.deployment.region.text: Plan: extend the service to the Grand Est region. No partnership has been concluded to date.
apropos.deployment.national.title: All of France
apropos.deployment.national.text: Long-term goal: a comprehensive, open map of social services across mainland France.
apropos.cta.title: Do you work in the social sector?
apropos.cta.text: Let’s meet to build what comes next, or list your organisation directly.
impact.seo_description: What AccesDirectAide publishes today, what is measured and what is not measured yet.
impact.title: Our impact
impact.description: We only publish measured figures. Here is what is measured today, and what is not yet.
impact.not_measured.title: What we do not measure yet
impact.not_measured.text: During the public beta, we do not measure the audience and no accounts are open: we know neither the number of visits nor the number of people helped. These figures will be published when they are measured, with their method.
impact.how.title: How these figures are obtained
impact.how.text: They count the pages visible on the site: each benefit, procedure or support centre is published only after an automatic, dated check against its official source (Service-Public, FINESS register, Annuaire de l’administration…).
impact.goals.title: What we want to improve
impact.goals.local.title: More local places and schemes
impact.goals.local.text: Check more organisations and the programmes of Strasbourg and the Eurométropole.
impact.goals.readers.title: Texts reviewed by readers
impact.goals.readers.text: Have the simplified versions reviewed by the people concerned.
impact.goals.usefulness.title: Measure real usefulness
impact.goals.usefulness.text: Define, with partners, a way of measuring that respects privacy.
impact.partners: Are you a support organisation or a funder? <0>Discover the partner area</0>.
partners.seo_description: An area for local authorities, associations and social organisations who wish to join the Accès Direct Aide ecosystem.
partners.title: Partner area
partners.description: Associations, CCAS, solidarity organisations and local authorities: how your organisation appears on AccesDirectAide, and how to reach us.
partners.beta.title: During the public beta
partners.beta.text: The professional area, organisation accounts and appointment booking are not open yet. Your organisation may already be in the directory: support centres are taken from official registers (FINESS, Annuaire de l’administration, SIRENE) and checked before publication.
partners.beta.search: Look for my organisation in the directory
partners.beta.privacy: To correct a page or propose a partnership, write to us. Do not send personal information about the people you support.
partners.offer.title_beta: What the partner area will make possible
partners.offer.title_open: Associations, CCAS, solidarity organisations: join the initiative
partners.offer.text: Accès Direct Aide is being rolled out to make life simpler for applicants and to ease the workload at professionals’ front desks.
partners.offer.beta: When it opens, the partner area will let you <0>keep your organisation’s page up to date</0> and receive referrals.
partners.offer.open: <0>List your organisation</0> in our directory to benefit from built-in appointment booking and civic visibility.
partners.features.visibility.title: Civic visibility
partners.features.visibility.text: Appear on the needs-assessment maps and genuinely reach the people you can help in your area.
partners.features.referrals.title: Clear referrals
partners.features.referrals.text: A referral reaches you with the stated need and the person’s consent; you can accept it, ask for more information or decline it (no capacity, outside your field).
partners.features.no_ads.title: No advertising, no paid ranking
partners.features.no_ads.text: No paid position in the directory or the results, and no personal data is sold. The terms for organisations will be published by the association.
partners.commitments.title: Our firm commitments
partners.commitments.review: You propose your opening hours, services and time slots; any change to your public page is reviewed by ADA before publication.
partners.commitments.history: Every change made to your page by ADA is dated, attributed and kept in the page’s history.
partners.commitments.errors: An error reported on your page is examined by ADA before any correction.
partners.join.title: Propose your organisation
partners.join.text: Your Pro area opens as soon as you register. Your page appears in the public directory, and can receive files, only after ADA has checked it.
